display.purpose: The wordmark only, once per page. Ceiling derived so nine characters fill ~91% of the 1632px measure.

headline.purpose: The closing statement — the only other place weight 900 appears.

title.purpose: The positioning statement and the lead tool's heading.

subtitle.purpose: Section headings, each struck by a censor bar.

body.purpose: All running prose in Spectral, held to a 46-58ch measure. Rises to 1.125rem at 48rem.

label.purpose: Target links, platform names, footer. Mono caps.

furniture.purpose: Desktop-only sheet numbers, section names, classifications. aria-hidden printed matter.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: The only non-scroll motion: hover and focus-visible ground inversion on every target.

motion.name: bar-lift
motion.value: animation: bar-lift linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: exit 0% exit 100%;
motion.purpose: Hero censor bars translate off (±115%) as the hero exits and never return.

motion.name: unredact
motion.value: animation: unredact linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 5% entry 45%; transform-origin: right center;
motion.purpose: Ink cover scales to 0 rightward as a statement line enters, revealing text in reading order. Staggered +7% per child.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.value: animation: rule-draw linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 8% entry 48%; transform-origin: left;
motion.purpose: A rule draws itself left to right as its block enters. The --late variant offsets to entry 16%-56%.

motion.name: stamp-land
motion.value: animation: stamp-land cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: cover 0% cover 30%;
motion.purpose: Closing stamp strikes down from rotate(-6deg) scale(1.08) to rotate(-2deg) scale(1). Transform only, cover range, because an entry range cannot complete at the foot of the document.

motion.name: motion-guard
motion.purpose: Both guards wrap every scroll effect. Covers and strikes exist only inside them, so the unguarded default state is always fully visible content.

components.name: Target Link
components.description: The standard bordered outbound target: mono caps plus a drawn arrow. Fills flame on hover and focus.
components.html: stormcount.gg
components.css: .ds-target { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-doc); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-target:hover, .ds-target:focus-visible { background-color: var(--color-flame); } .ds-target:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-target-arrow { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.name: Target Link (Lead)
components.description: The commercially leading item's target: flame-filled at rest, inverting to ink on interaction. Exactly one per page.
components.html: findthatcard.net
components.css: .ds-target-lead { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; background-color: var(--color-flame); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-doc); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-target-lead:hover, .ds-target-lead:focus-visible { background-color: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-stock); } .ds-target-lead:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-target-lead-arrow { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.name: Follow Tile
components.description: The page's primary conversion. Flame-filled by default because hover does not exist on the phones most visitors arrive on.
components.html: TikTok@cardboardcultist
components.css: .ds-follow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 16px 20px; border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; background-color: var(--color-flame); color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-follow:hover, .ds-follow:focus-visible { background-color: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-stock); } .ds-follow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-follow-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-follow-label { font-family: var(--font-doc); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-follow-handle { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 75%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-follow-arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; }

components.name: Stamp (Filled)
components.description: The motto, stamped on flame at -2deg. Rotation is a stamping gesture reserved for stamps only.
components.css: .ds-stamp-filled { display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-2deg); padding: 8px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; background-color: var(--color-flame); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-doc); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; margin: 0; }

components.name: Stamp (Outline)
components.description: The closing stamp — the redaction lifted rather than the assertion restated. Lands on a transform-only scroll animation.
components.css: .ds-stamp-outline { display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-2deg); padding: 8px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-doc); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; margin: 0; }

components.name: Struck Sheet Heading
components.description: The signature device: a censor bar registered on twelfths that inverts the letterforms beneath it via mix-blend-mode difference. The bar is a child of the heading because em resolves against the nearest element's font-size.
components.html: Two things I built instead of sleeping.
components.css: .ds-sheet-heading { position: relative; isolation: isolate; max-width: 20ch; margin: 0; background-color: var(--color-stock); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem); font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 75%; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-censor-bar { position: absolute; left: 16.667%; width: 50%; top: 0.30em; height: 0.16em; background-color: var(--color-stock); mix-blend-mode: difference; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Margin Furniture
components.description: Desktop-only document apparatus in the tenth column: registration crop mark, sheet number, section name, classification. aria-hidden printed matter, never rendered on phones.
components.html:
Sheet 03 / 05
Tools
Unrestricted
components.css: .ds-furniture { border-left: 1px solid var(--color-rule); padding-left: 16px; color: var(--color-halftone); } .ds-furniture-mark { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-furniture-list { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-doc); font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.625; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-furniture-list dd { margin: 0; } .ds-furniture-name { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-furniture-class { margin-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule); padding-top: 12px; }

components.name: Drawn Rule
components.description: The closed set of three line weights: 1px hairline for dormant items, 3px ink standard, 6px ink for the single leading item. Each draws itself left to right on entry.
components.css: .ds-rule-lead, .ds-rule, .ds-rule-hairline { display: block; width: 100%; transform-origin: left; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-rule-lead { height: 6px; background-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-rule { height: 3px; background-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-rule-hairline { height: 1px; background-color: var(--color-rule); }

narrative.overview:
This is a printed document that leaked. It is set on brand cream stock in toner black, ruled with hard 1px and 3px lines, numbered in its own margin ("Sheet 03 / 05"), and struck through with censor bars that register exactly on column edges. The redaction is the signature device and the joke: every bar is a mix-blend-mode: difference panel, so it inverts the letterforms underneath instead of erasing them. The page is about a category that hoards information behind embargoes, and it withholds nothing — the strikes are theatre you can read straight through, and the copy is legible with JavaScript off, with scroll-timelines unsupported, and under reduced motion.

Density is high and deliberately uneven. Nothing is centred, nothing is a matched pair, nothing has a rounded corner, and there is not a single shadow in the build. Depth is carried by a named four-plane z-system and by asymmetric column placement, never by parallax or elevation. Two visual rejections are confirmed in the artifact: the fantasy-art hero with a row of social icons, and the clean white sans page that is its opposite. A third is confirmed by reversion: a symmetric two-card grid for the tools, which flattened a real difference between a utility and a game.

The type does the shouting. Archivo at weight 900 and width 75% is set to the wordmark's own proportion and fills roughly 91% of the measure at every viewport; Spectral carries all running prose at a comfortable serif measure; JetBrains Mono is confined to document furniture — sheet numbers, classifications, domains, labels. Flame orange appears only as a filled ground, never as ink and never as a line.
keyCharacteristics: Cream stock ground, toner-black ink, zero radius anywhere
Censor bars that invert rather than cover, registered on twelfths
Three faces with three fixed jobs: condensed display, serif prose, mono furniture
Flame orange as fill only, never text, never a rule, never a border
Static named planes; no parallax, no shadows, no elevation
Every motion effect double-guarded, with the unanimated state fully readable

rules.name: The Fill-Only Rule
rules.body: Flame is a ground, never a mark. It may fill a box that ink sits on; it may never be text, a rule, a border, an icon stroke, or a hairline. Audit test: if you can delete the flame and the shape still has an outline, it was used correctly.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy between two peer items is signalled by rule weight and heading scale, never by recolouring one of them. The lead tool carries a 6px ink rule against the follower's 3px. A flame rule was built here and reverted: at 2.6:1 it read lighter than the follower's ink rule and argued against the hierarchy the type had already established.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Dormancy is drawn in halftone and hairline (1px rule cream), currency in ink and 3px. Presenting an archived thing and a live thing alike either abandons the live one or resurrects the dead one.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo is always uppercase, always width 75%, always negatively tracked, and never sets a sentence of prose. Spectral never sets a heading. JetBrains Mono never sets prose — it labels, numbers, classifies, and names domains. The three jobs do not swap.

rules.name: The Tighter-As-Bigger Rule
rules.body: Tracking scales inversely with size: -0.035em at display, -0.03em at headline, -0.02em at title and subtitle, -0.01em at entry, and positive 0.16-0.18em on mono labels. Line-height moves with it: 0.85 at display up to 1.6 at body.

rules.name: The Measured-Glyph Rule
rules.body: Below line-height 1 the letterforms overflow their line boxes. Any element positioned against display type — strikes, ascender clearance — is offset against the rendered glyph extents, not the layout box, and the compensating pad is expressed in the same unit as the font size so it cannot drift.

rules.name: The Twelfths Rule
rules.body: Strike geometry is expressed in twelfths (8.333%, 16.667%, 41.667%, 50%) so the redaction registers against the same grid as the type. Arbitrary percentages break the registration that is the whole conceit.

rules.name: The Margin-Needs-A-Margin Rule
rules.body: Document furniture is desktop-only by design. There is no margin on a phone, and in flow it reads as a caption under the heading — in the close it physically interrupted the path between the pitch and the conversion. It is not "hidden for space"; it is absent because its container does not exist.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and flat in every state. A raised or offset shadow is foreign to this world — separation comes from a 3px border, a rule, or a plane assignment.

rules.name: The Applied-Last Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders above --plane-strike. If a new element needs to sit over a censor bar, the element is wrong, not the plane.

rules.name: The Default-Affordance Rule
rules.body: A target's clickability is visible before interaction. Most traffic arrives in iOS in-app browsers where hover never fires; an affordance that only exists in a hover state ships as no affordance at all.

rules.name: The Em-Resolves-Locally Rule
rules.body: A strike must be a child of the element whose font-size it is measured against. em resolves against the nearest element's own font-size — a sibling overlay sized these against body text and rendered them roughly 13x too small.

rules.name: The Strike-Ends-In-The-Glyph-Run Rule
rules.body: A bar must terminate inside the letterforms it crosses. Overhang past the last glyph is a stray rectangle, not a redaction. Shipped measurements: tools bar ends at 66.7% against glyphs reaching 79.9%; archive 41.7% against 53.3%; close 50% against 55.8%. This defect was introduced twice; measure against rendered glyphs before changing a strike.

rules.name: The Double-Guard Rule
rules.body: Every scroll effect lives inside both @supports (animation-timeline: view()) and @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). This is a safety rule, not a stylistic one: a covering bar exists only inside the guards, so where the feature is unsupported or motion is reduced, no cover is ever drawn and the text is simply visible. A blindfold must never be able to become permanent.

rules.name: The Transform-Only-At-The-Foot Rule
rules.body: Never animate opacity from 0 on an element near the end of the document. The closing stamp did, on an entry range that cannot complete with only a footer beneath it, and fill: both pinned it at opacity: 0 — the last element on the page shipped permanently invisible. It animates transform only, on a cover 0%-30% range, so an incomplete range degrades to a slightly different angle rather than to nothing.

dos: Do treat flame as a ground only — ink on flame is 5.9:1 and passes; flame on stock is 2.6:1 and fails.
Do register every censor bar on twelfths, and terminate it inside the glyph run it crosses.
Do render a strike as a child of the element whose font-size sizes it, inside an isolate group with an explicit stock background.
Do wrap every scroll-linked effect in both the @supports and the prefers-reduced-motion guard, and make the unguarded state the fully-visible one.
Do mark hierarchy with rule weight (1px / 3px / 6px) and heading scale, never with hue.
Do set display type uppercase at width 75% with negative tracking, and measure positions against rendered glyph extents when line-height drops below 1.
Do give every interactive target a visible affordance at rest and a 44px minimum height; mirror every :hover treatment on :focus-visible.
Do draw icons as inline SVG strokes at the system's line weights.
donts: Don't use flame for text, a rule, a border, an icon stroke, or a hairline.
Don't add a border radius. Zero is the value, everywhere.
Don't add a shadow of any kind — this system has none, and separation comes from borders, rules, and named planes.
Don't animate a text plane's position on scroll: fractional translateY costs subpixel antialiasing and renders drifting copy visibly softer than its neighbours.
Don't animate opacity from 0 on any element near the foot of the document.
Don't introduce a line weight outside 1px / 3px / 6px, or a rotation outside the -2deg stamp gesture.
Don't place margin furniture in the content flow on phones — it reads as a stray caption and, on the close, interrupts the conversion path.
Don't present two peer items as a matched symmetric pair when one genuinely leads; and don't present a dormant item at the same weight as a live one.
Don't use a unicode glyph, an icon font, or a social logo mark where a drawn SVG stroke belongs.
